meta.name: image-seo
meta.description: Image SEO audit — make a site's images discoverable in Google Images and stop them from dragging down Core Web Vitals. Audits alt text quality and coverage, descriptive file names, modern formats (WebP/AVIF), dimensions and compression, responsive srcset, lazy-loading, explicit width/height (CLS), image sitemaps, and ImageObject structured data. Use this skill whenever the user asks about image SEO, alt text, Google Images ranking, image optimization for search, image file size hurting page speed, WebP/AVIF, or image structured data. Trigger on: "image SEO", "alt text", "rank in Google Images", "optimize my images for search", "image alt tags", "WebP", "image compression SEO", "image sitemap", "ImageObject schema", or any image-discoverability / image-performance question. For overall page speed use /seo-analysis; for generating new images use the brand image skills.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提升网站图片在谷歌图片搜索中的排名与性能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果网站图片在谷歌图片中排名低或拖慢页面速度
copy.tagline_en: Boost your site's image discoverability in Google Images and Core Web Vitals
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your site images rank poorly in Google Images or hurt page speed

howto.what: 装了之后,你给它一个网址,它会检查页面上的每张图片,找出图片在谷歌图片搜索里不显眼、或拖慢网页打开速度的原因,然后给出评分和具体修改建议。
howto.when: 当你说到“图片SEO”“alt文本”“图片压缩”等关键词,或问图片在谷歌图片里的排名时触发。

say.text: 检查我网站图片的alt文字写得对不对
say.note: 它会逐张检查缺失、重复或无效的alt描述。

say.text: 我的图片太大影响加载速度,怎么改?
say.note: 它会给出压缩、换格式等具体建议。

howto.what_en: After installing, give it a URL and it will check every image on the page, find why they are underperforming in Google Images or slowing down page load, then provide a score and concrete fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user mentions 'image SEO', 'alt text', 'image compression', or asks about image ranking in Google Images.

say_en.text: Audit the image SEO of this page: https://example.com/products
say_en.note: It crawls the page images and returns a detailed issue list.

say_en.text: Check if the alt texts on my site images are good
say_en.note: It checks each image for missing, duplicate, or bad alt descriptions.

say_en.text: My images are too large and slow down the page, how to fix?
say_en.note: It gives actionable tips like compression and format conversion.
